name: Chorus
tagline: An AAC system that helps people who cannot speak easily compose and start conversations faster.
problem: Assistive communication users type far slower than people speak, which keeps them reacting instead of initiating; the team cites roughly 15 versus 150 words per minute.
solution: An active augmentative communication system with text, picture and suggestion modes, AI highlighting, icon generation and scheduling to shorten the path from thought to speech.
demo_moment: Team-described: switch modes and see a full sentence ready in a few selections.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Built from friends and community members who live with the problem.

lessons: A measurable gap (words per minute) frames an accessibility pitch better than adjectives.
